test_restore_checkpoint: test restoring Detectron model checkpoint weights from a saved pickle file and verify correctness
get_params: get all model parameter blobs including trainable momentum blobs from a Detectron model
add_momentum_init_ops: add GaussianFill momentum initialization ops for all trainable parameters in a Detectron model
init_weights: initialize model weights by running the param init net and broadcasting parameters across GPUs
run_test_restore_checkpoint: run the checkpoint restore test across all available CUDA devices with varying GPU counts
